_readme: Edit this file, then restart the launcher (cog > Restart launcher, or press Home). The helper re-reads it on every request and serves it inside /apps, so nothing needs rebuilding or reinstalling. Order in 'dock' is the order on screen; ids must exist in /query/apps.
_icons: change a tile's icon without the remote: switch, gamepad, playstation, raspberrypi, speaker, hdmi, av, livetv, stock, generic
_background: wallpaper comes from /photo: Immich if configured, otherwise a random image from helper/photos. Drop .jpg or .png files there and they appear.
_wallpaper_note: Photos are off: 'solid' is a flat dark background with no rotation. Set ['weather:Kyoto', ...] or ['immich'] to turn images back on; 'photos' uses helper/photos.
